name: MonarchVersionHistoryPanel
title: VersionHistoryPanel
wrapsNative: NavigationStack(path:) with a List of NavigationLink rows and navigationDestination(for:), a segmented Picker, MonarchDiffViewer and confirmationDialog; presented by the app in .sheet or .inspector
summary: The version history of a document or record: the saved versions, what changed between a version and now, its full text, and restore behind a confirmation.
whenToUse: For a document, page or record whose versions are kept, when people need to see what changed and go back to an earlier version.
whenNotToUse: Not for a log of who did what (use MonarchActivityTimeline), and not for comparing two arbitrary texts (use MonarchDiffViewer).
api: init(_ title: String? = nil, versions: [MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion], selection: Binding<String?>, currentLines: [String], selectedLines: [String]? = nil, currentID: String? = nil, isLoading: Bool = false, labels: MonarchVersionHistoryPanelLabels = MonarchVersionHistoryPanelLabels(), onSaveVersion: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil, onRestore: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil, onClose: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

struct MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion: Identifiable, Sendable { init(id: String, date: Date, authorName: String, authorImage: Image?, note: String? = nil, isAutomatic: Bool = false); init(id: String, date: Date, authorName: String, authorURL: URL? = nil, note: String? = nil, isAutomatic: Bool = false) }

struct MonarchVersionHistoryPanelLabels: Sendable { init(close:noteLabel:notePlaceholder:save:saved:saveFailed:empty:current:automatic:versions:changes:fullText:now:identical:restore:restoreTitle:restoreDescription:restoreConfirm:restored:restoreFailed:loading:view: String? = nil, diff: MonarchDiffViewerLabels = MonarchDiffViewerLabels()) }

options.name: title
options.description: The title of the list. "History" when nil.

options.name: versions
options.description: The saved versions, newest first: id, date, author name and picture, name and whether it was saved automatically.

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the version on screen, or nil for the list. It is the navigation path; the back button and gesture set it to nil.

options.name: currentLines
options.description: The content now, one entry per block or paragraph.

options.name: selectedLines
options.description: The selected version's content. Load it when selection changes; a placeholder shows while it is nil.

options.name: currentID
options.description: The version that matches the content now, marked Current and without Restore. The newest when nil.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows redacted placeholder rows while the list loads.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, and the diff's strings.

options.name: onSaveVersion
options.description: Shows a name field and Save version at the top of the list. Receives the trimmed name (at most 200 characters). Throw to show an error.

options.name: onRestore
options.description: Shows Restore this version on versions other than the current one, behind a confirmation. Throw to keep the screen with an error; on success the list shows again.

options.name: onClose
options.description: Shows a Close button in the navigation bar.

states.name: list
states.description: The versions, each with an avatar, a relative time, the author and the name; the current one has an info badge.

states.name: empty
states.description: An empty state: "No versions yet. Save one to mark this moment."

states.name: saving
states.description: Save version shows progress and the name field is disabled; an error shows under it.

states.name: version, loading
states.description: The version's screen shows redacted lines until selectedLines arrives.

states.name: changes
states.description: A diff of the version against now, with totals and folded unchanged runs, or "This version is identical to the current one."

states.name: restoring
states.description: Restore shows progress after the confirmation; an error shows above it.

appearance: System list rows with the default and muted text roles, a subtle info badge for Current, and the diff's success and danger roles for added and removed lines. Dark and high-contrast themes resolve the same roles.
platformNotes: The web is an aside panel that swaps its list for a detail view with tabs; on iPhone it is a navigation stack with the system back button and swipe gesture, a segmented control for the two views and the system confirmation dialog for restore. The app presents it in a sheet, or in an inspector beside the document on iPad. Times are relative and refresh every minute through TimelineView; the absolute date is written on the version's screen instead of a tooltip. Android uses the same name.
accessibility: Each version is one navigation link read as the relative time, the author and the version's name or "Saved automatically"; the current version has the value "Current".
Avatars are decorative, because the author's name is written beside them.
On the version's screen the author line and the date are read as one element, and the navigation title is the relative time.
The diff is read as described for MonarchDiffViewer: each line after "Added" or "Removed".
"Version saved", "Version restored" and the save and restore errors are announced.
Restore is behind the system confirmation dialog with a destructive button and the system Cancel.
edgeCases: A selection that is not among versions shows an empty screen until the list contains it.
Long names and notes wrap in the rows.
Version names are cut to 200 characters, as on the web.
Restore is never offered on the current version.

examples.title: Browse, compare, save and restore
examples.template:
MonarchVersionHistoryPanel(
    {{title}},
    versions: versions,
    selection: $selection,
    currentLines: content[{{versions.0.id}}] ?? [],
    selectedLines: selection.flatMap { content[$0] },
    currentID: {{versions.0.id}},
    onSaveVersion: { _ in },
    onRestore: { _ in },
    onClose: { selection = nil }
)
examples.setupTemplate:
@State private var selection: String?

private let content: [String: [String]] = [
    {{versions.0.id}}: [{{versions.0.lines.0}}, {{versions.0.lines.1}}, {{versions.0.lines.2}}, {{versions.0.lines.3}}, {{versions.0.lines.4}}],
    {{versions.1.id}}: [{{versions.1.lines.0}}, {{versions.1.lines.1}}, {{versions.1.lines.2}}, {{versions.1.lines.3}}],
    {{versions.2.id}}: [{{versions.2.lines.0}}, {{versions.2.lines.1}}, {{versions.2.lines.2}}],
    {{versions.3.id}}: [{{versions.3.lines.0}}, {{versions.3.lines.1}}],
]
private let versions = [
    MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion(id: {{versions.0.id}}, date: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -{{versions.0.ageSeconds}}), authorName: {{versions.0.author}}),
    MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion(id: {{versions.1.id}}, date: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -{{versions.1.ageSeconds}}), authorName: {{versions.1.author}}, note: {{versions.1.note}}),
    MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion(id: {{versions.2.id}}, date: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -{{versions.2.ageSeconds}}), authorName: {{versions.2.author}}, isAutomatic: {{versions.2.automatic}}),
    MonarchVersionHistoryPanelVersion(id: {{versions.3.id}}, date: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -{{versions.3.ageSeconds}}), authorName: {{versions.3.author}}, note: {{versions.3.note}}),
]
